name: figma-animator
description: Browse Figma variants and resume exact-prompt animation reviews in a native workspace.

interface.longDescription: Open the Figma library, select real variants, compose start frames and review exact H3 prompts in one saved animation workspace. Follow batch progress, reopen results and use explicit chat confirmation in clients without custom UI.
interface.defaultPrompt: Animate a Figma ad across its available aspect ratios with reviewed compositions and exact prompts.
